question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"astonishment."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"astonishment"** means a feeling of great surprise or amazement. (अति विस्‍मय, आश्‍चर्य, हैरानी)

 
 
• **Example:** *He dropped his book in **astonishment**__.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The other options do not make sense in the given sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• **Correct passage**:

To my utter __**astonishment,**__ the little dark boy was striding ______ (2) ______ up and down the lawn while the white youngster walked ______ (3) ______ behind him. “Get me a banana!” The little boy ran ______ (4) ______ the house and ______ (5) ______ shortly.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Puzzle**: A game, toy, or problem designed to test ingenuity or knowledge. (जिसे समझना या समझाना कठिन हो; गूढ़ बात, रहस्‍य)
 
• **Order**: The arrangement or disposition of people or things in relation to each other according to a particular sequence, pattern, or method. (व्‍यवस्थित क्रम, सिलसिला)
 
• **Realisation**: The action of understanding or becoming aware of something. (अनुमति, (कार्य) सिद्धि)
